item.title: Mergable software, or how to drive ephemeral agent browsers
item.description:
I’ve been using sockpuppetbrowser for a while in some of my projects. The easy method of opening a CDP connection and getting a browser (which scales to a couple of jobs) is nice enough for projects of mine. While also keeping each proces seperate.

However the repo has grown stale and some bugs are nagging me (crashed browsers & memory issues). I’ve hotfixed them in my own branch, but when I came across Obscura I knew I had to try to merge the two! (I know obscure serve --workers N, but those are sticky, I wanted something more ephemeral!)
